title: Travel Agents: Taiwan — the table (V7 · 3–6 players)

clock_model.driver: the BOOKING (開團) deck — DECK-DRIVEN, NOT a numbered track
clock_model.dusk: 黃昏 DUSK — fires when the DAY Booking deck is exhausted (seeded 黃昏 boundary card at the deck's bottom); flip the board to night
clock_model.last_train: 末班車 LAST TRAIN — fires when the NIGHT Booking deck is exhausted (seeded 末班車 boundary card); finish the round, then end
clock_model.retired: the vendor-claims clock, its dusk@/last-train@ thresholds, the +1-on-Bribe step, and the stall backstop are ALL DELETED (§11 canon — one clock, deck-driven, guaranteed to fire)

booking_deck_sizes._rule: DAY = 3·(N+1), NIGHT = 4·(N+1) (SIM-VALIDATED; reconciles §11's earlier N+2 draft to what the sim actually validated). The seeded boundary card sits BELOW these counts.

vendor_slots._note: face-up vendor slots per region (N/C/S/E). NIGHT uses the SAME per-count counts as DAY (§4 — one slot table). Slots stay BELOW the player count (~1.5–2.0 stalls/agent) so collisions are forced — the area-majority engine. `slots_n` on each region below is the 4p HOME default for the render.
